description: Irradiation solaire annuelle is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Kanton Genf. L'irradiation solaire correspond à l'énergie solaire incidente sur une surface (pixel) durant une période donnée. Elle exprimée en kWh /m2, c'est-à-dire en quantité d'énergie solaire par m2. Coverage: Kanton Genf. The portal files it under the publisher Kanton Genf. It offers 2 resource(s) in API, TIFF. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
